title: index
overview:
This is the **first page of the index** (printed page 609, PDF 633). It opens with the large *index* title and covers the letter **A**, from *abstraction acquisition* to *axis_names argument*.

**How to use it.** Index entries cite **printed** page numbers. To find the page in this PDF companion, **add 24** (for example, printed 464 becomes PDF 488). Indented lines are sub-entries of the heading above them, and a range such as 576–584 means a continuous discussion.

**What clusters here.**
- **AI and AGI, the big picture.** *AI (artificial intelligence)* 2 (PDF 26) has many sub-entries: AI winters 14 (PDF 38), building intelligence 576–584 (PDF 600–608), local vs. extreme generalization 573 (PDF 597), search and symbols 584–594 (PDF 608–618), and future developments 606 (PDF 630). Related entries are *AGI* 13, 571, 594 (PDF 37, 595, 618), *ARC-AGI* 581, 583 (PDF 605, 607), *ARC Prize* 581, *abstraction acquisition* 578 (PDF 602), *automatons* 571 and *AI summer* 597.
- **Attention.** *attention* 464 (PDF 488), with *dot-product attention* 439 (PDF 463) and *Transformer architecture* 437 (PDF 461). *attention_mask* is at 446–447 (PDF 470–471).
- **Optimizers.** *adam optimizer* 247, 379, 490 (PDF 271, 403, 514) and *AdamW optimizer* 529 (PDF 553).
- **Models and techniques.** *autoencoders* 510 (PDF 534), *autoregressive model* 426 (PDF 450), *activation functions* 109 (PDF 133), *adversarial examples* 567 (PDF 591), *anomaly detection* 352 (PDF 376), *augmenting text data* 413.
- **Keras API names.** *adapt()* 399, *add()* 192, *append()* 192, *axis_names argument* 553 (distribution API).
